description.content: A view policy specifies view configuration parameters. A view policy can be used by multiple views. Every view is attached to one view policy.

This endpoint lists view policies. By default, all view policies are returned. The list can be filtered using optional parameters. A view policy is a reusable set of configurations that apply to views. Every view has a view policy. A view policy may be used by multiple views.

query.description: Filter by smb_file_mode. smb_file_mode is the default unix permission bits applied to files created by SMB clients. It is relevant only to views that are exposed to both SMB and NFS access protocols and have NFS security flavor.

Filter by smb_directory_mode. smb_directory_mode is the default unix permission bits applied to directories created by SMB clients. It is relevant only to views that are exposed to both SMB and NFS access protocols and have NFS security flavor.
Filter by tenant. Specify tenant ID.
Filter by served tenants. Accepts tenant ID or "all" for all served tenants.
